item.title: Will Copper Turn My Skin Green? The Honest Truth and Easy Fixes
item.description: One of the most common questions I receive as a jewelry creator is: “Will this copper ring turn my skin green?” It is a completely natural fear. Many people notice a colorful mark after wearing a beautiful copper piece and worry that they are having an allergic reaction or that the jewelry is poor quality.

item.title: Lacquered vs. Raw Copper Jewelry: Which One is Right for You?
item.description:
Copper is a magical, living metal with a rich history. It has been used for thousands of years to create intricate ornaments, talismans, and wearable art. However, if you are looking to bring a new piece of copper jewelry into your life, you will quickly face an important choice: Lacquered or Raw Copper?

As a jewelry creator, I work deeply with both finishes. Each has its own unique personality, practical benefits, and inner energy.
